data.name: Israr
data.gender_notes: Israr is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is firm and unwavering in their beliefs and actions. The name Israr carries the meaning “Steadfast” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Israr usually hope their child will grow to embody steadfast and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A quality of a true believer, to remain steadfast in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Israr belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Steadfast.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Israr total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: إصرار
in_arabic.long_meaning: الإصرار هو المتابعة والاستمرار في الشيء مع الإيمان والاحتمال، وهو من أسماء الله الحسنى في الإسلام، ومشتق من الجذر العربي صرر، والذي يعني الاستمرار والتماسك، وذكرت في القرآن الكريم في سياق الثواب على الصبر والاستمرار

in_urdu.name: اصرار
in_urdu.long_meaning: اصرار کا مطلب ہے کسی کام کو جاری رکھنا اور اس میں مستقل رہنا، یہ نام عربي gốc سے لیا گیا ہے، اور اس کی معنائیں اسلام میں بہت اہم ہیں، کیونکہ یہ نام اللہ کی صفات میں سے ایک ہے

in_hindi.name: इसरार
in_hindi.long_meaning: इसरार का अर्थ है किसी काम को जारी रखना और उसमें स्थिर रहना, यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, और इसके अर्थ इस्लाम में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण हैं, क्योंकि यह نام अल्लाह की विशेषताओं में से एक है

in_pashto.name: اصرار
in_pashto.meaning: د اصرار د پايښت او دوام عمل
in_pashto.long_meaning: د اصرار د پايښت او دوام په nghĩa کې دی، چې د یو کار په جاری ساتلو او په هغه کې د دوام په nghĩa کې دی، دا نوم د عربي ریشې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، او دا نوم په اسلام کې ډیر महत्वपورن دی

in_english.name: Israr
in_english.meaning: persistence and continuity in an action
in_english.long_meaning: Israr refers to the act of persistence and continuity in an action with faith and perseverance, it is one of the names of Allah in Islam, derived from the Arabic root sr-r, meaning persistence and coherence, mentioned in the Quran in the context of reward for patience and persistence

pronunciation.urdu: اصرار کا تلفظ اس طرح ہے اصرار
pronunciation.hindi: इसरार का उच्चारण इस प्रकार है इस-रार
pronunciation.pashto: د اصرار د تلفظ د پديده

data.cultural_impact: The name Israr carries a sense of strength and steadfastness. In Islamic culture, it is believed that having a strong and unwavering character is highly valuable. This name could be given to a child as an inspiration for them to remain firm in their beliefs and actions, even in the face of adversity. It can also serve as a reminder to individuals to stand strong in their convictions and not waiver, especially during challenging times.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual sense, the name Israr signifies one who is steadfast in their faith and devotion to God. It is believed that remaining firm in one's beliefs and actions is an important aspect of building a strong spiritual foundation. The name Israr can serve as a reminder to individuals to stay focused on their spiritual journey and not be swayed by distractions or temptations. It also represents the idea of having a consistent and unwavering connection with God, no matter what circumstances arise.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Steadfast" symbolizes One who is firm and unwavering in their beliefs and actions.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Israr serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of steadfast.
